definitions.gloss: volunteer fire corps; community fire brigade
definitions.explanation: A locally organized body of resident volunteers who assist with firefighting, disaster response, and prevention alongside the professional fire service. Formed from {消防|しょうぼう} (firefighting) and {団|だん} (group, corps).

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{消防団|しょうぼうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: My father belongs to the volunteer fire corps.

examples.japanese: {消防団|しょうぼうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防災訓練|ぼうさいくんれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The volunteer fire corps carried out a disaster-prevention drill for the community.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{消防団|しょうぼうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: In rural areas, the volunteer fire corps is an important presence supporting residents' safety.

notes:
Members are ordinary residents who train and turn out part-time, distinct from the full-time staff of a ⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧. Especially important in rural areas with few professional stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消防団|しょうぼうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join the volunteer fire corps
- {消防団|しょうぼうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{団員|だんいん}→団員：23732_danin⟧: a member of the fire corps
- {消防団|しょうぼうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: fire corps activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧: fire station — staffed by professional, full-time firefighters.
- ⟦{消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}→消防隊員：29793_shouboutaiin⟧: firefighter — a paid professional, not a volunteer.
